# Goal: Wire engine integration, pass acceptance gate, ship remaining surfaces

**Goal ID:** goal-20260612-1915
**Stopping condition:** 10-point acceptance gate passes end-to-end + 3-pane layout live + unified search working + `bun run typecheck && bun test` green
**Guardrails:**
- group_id `^allura-[a-z0-9-]+$` on every write
- Append-only events, SUPERSEDES versioning
- HITL gate on all promotions
- Events-first write order (event INSERT → snapshot UPDATE)
- Max 10 Ralph iterations
- Tools: Allura Brain, Notion, Context7, Figma, Vercel, built-in, Team RAM, BMad skills
**Created:** 2026-06-12T19:15:00Z

---

## Context

Phases 0-5 infrastructure shipped in prior session. 8 modules, 14 API routes, 8 dashboard pages, 2,444 tests. The remaining work is integration + proof + two UI surfaces. The retro identified 6 carry-forwards; this goal covers the P0 and P1 items.

---

## Tasks

- [ ] 1. **Engine.ts integration** — Wire definition-registry, run-manager, and quality-gate into ProcessEngine. Engine.run() creates a PG snapshot via run-manager. Engine steps use events-first write order. Engine resume uses DAG successor resolution with the new modules. Tests prove the wiring.

- [ ] 2. **10-point acceptance gate — steps 1-3** — Write an integration test that: creates a work item via work-item-manager, starts a versioned run via definition-registry + run-manager, dispatches parallel agent tasks via DAG engine.

- [ ] 3. **10-point acceptance gate — steps 4-6** — Continue the test: hit a human breakpoint (checkpoint blocks), resume after approval (checkpoint_resumed with approved_by), pass a measured quality gate (scored, evidence-linked).

- [ ] 4. **10-point acceptance gate — steps 7-10** — Complete the test: produce an evidence packet (evidence-manager), close work item via audited transition (work-item-manager), write outcome to Brain (memory_add), verify state reconstructable from events + snapshots.

- [ ] 5. **3-pane layout** — Implement the workspace shell: left rail (existing sidebar), center working surface (existing page content), right inspector panel (context, evidence, provenance). Resizable panels.

- [ ] 6. **Right inspector panel** — Build the evidence/context inspector: shows owner, approvals, evidence packets, provenance, freshness, and related memory for the selected entity (run, work item, project).

- [ ] 7. **Unified search** — `/dashboard/search` rewrite: search across projects, work items, runs, evidence, and approved memory. Federated query across PG tables + Brain memory_search. Results grouped by entity type.

- [ ] 8. **Work item detail page** — `/dashboard/work-board/[id]/page.tsx`: full work item view with status, transitions, linked run, evidence trail, dependencies, handoff history.

- [ ] 9. **Graph staleness — promote session traces** — Run curator triage on new proposals. Promote architecture decisions and session outcomes to Neo4j.

- [ ] 10. **Final validation + push** — `bun run typecheck && bun test`, invariant 6/6 check, Brain outcome trace, push to origin.

---

## Completion Check

1. Integration test for 10-point acceptance gate passes
2. 3-pane layout renders with resizable panels
3. Unified search returns results across all entity types
